scope: Exact-file preflight hardening for the already-recorded ASPC research TIFF. This is validation tooling, not a new geological experiment or a claim of organizer acceptance.

implemented: Shared gems.preflight module that independently reports exact-file format checks, strict whole-array range compatibility, pinned template bytes, note length, and hash-bound promotion evidence.
CLI scripts/preflight_submission.py; it writes a JSON receipt and never contacts DrivenData or uploads a file.
Static-site gate: the active lane build fails if the active preflight is absent, stale, or does not report DO_NOT_SUBMIT.
First-screen and executive-summary links to the exact preflight receipt.
pass_1_implementation.observed_result: The zero-outside ASPC TIFF is float32, one band, on the pinned template grid, finite and in [0,1] over the footprint and under a strict whole-array test. Its run card is hash-bound but has negative verdict and submission_authorized=false, so the automated decision is DO_NOT_SUBMIT.

fixed: A self-consistent custom template cannot yield OK_TO_SUBMIT without an explicit expected template SHA-256.
A malformed, hash-mismatched, renamed, non-promoted, or non-authorized run card cannot yield scientific authorization.
NaN-outside encoding is distinguished from a stricter whole-array [0,1] portal-compatibility diagnostic rather than silently treated as a cause of the reported portal error.
Receipt output omits local absolute paths so it can be published and reproduced in another checkout.
tests: A negative ASPC file may pass format and strict-range checks yet still returns DO_NOT_SUBMIT.
Its NaN-outside twin is format-valid but fails the stricter whole-array range diagnostic.
A synthetic unit-only promoted card verifies that every required hash-bound gate is needed for an OK_TO_SUBMIT path.

requirements_covered: One-click TIFF remains at the first screen with explicit DO NOT SUBMIT wording.

Unique filename, SHA-256, and a 93-character note are captured in the receipt.
No score, current leaderboard value, organizer receipt, portal access, or promotion was invented.
remaining_blockers: The ASPC run is on a provisional unassigned lane.
No current-best comparable OOF reconstruction exists.
The exact artifact has no completed nuisance audit or selector authorization.
The pinned sample is an owner mirror; it is not independently organizer-authenticated.
The local strict range check is not an organizer portal acceptance receipt.
next_steps: Do not spend a competition slot on ASPC. Obtain an assigned lane and reconstruct a current comparable OOF benchmark before a new preregistered hypothesis.
